pages.title: Ore and Pressing
pages.text: Fractured Phase Ore occurs in the Overworld, Nether, and End. A sandstone variant also forms in Duat. It drops Fractured Phase Ore Chunks.$(br2)Drop the chunks as item entities and strike them with a falling anvil. Each chunk has an independent 35% chance to be destroyed; each survivor becomes an ingot.

pages.title: Draconic Authority Ingot
pages.text: The chain consumes copper, iron, gold, diamond, Netherite Scrap, a Nether Star, and a Dragon Head in that order. Each step requires the previous phase-law metal.
